DeterminationBasis: T02-006 establishes that the declared canonicalisation procedure explicitly defines every applicable byte-producing representation dimension and produces reproducible canonical bytes. T05-006 independently re-reads preserved package material and recomputes the declared digest using the declared hashing procedure. Together these existing controls establish the canonicalisation-plus-independent-rehashability obligation required where cryptographic receipt identity is claimed. A receipt-specific duplicate test is not required.

T11-001 directly establishes that execution activity is not equivalent to completed consequence, records attempt and consequence independently, and fails if an execution attempt alone is represented as completed consequence. T11-004 preserves the same distinction when consequence observation cannot be obtained by retaining NOT_ESTABLISHED rather than manufacturing completion. No additional test is required.
